🚚 **Shipping Information**

📦 **Delivery Options:**
• Standard delivery: 2-5 business days — **FREE** on orders over 1,500 ETB
• Express delivery: 1-2 business days — **200 ETB**

• Nationwide delivery available to all Ethiopian regions

bot.returns_info:
🔄 **Return & Exchange Policy**

✅ **What We Accept:**
• Returns within **3 days** of delivery
• Items must be unused, unwashed, and in original packaging with tags
• Defective or damaged items — **FREE return + full refund**
• Wrong item sent — **FREE return + free replacement**

❌ **Non-Returnable Items:**
• Personalized/custom-made products
• Perishable goods
• Items marked as final sale

💰 **Refund Timeline:**
• Telebirr/Mobile payments: 2-3 business days
• Bank transfers: 3-5 business days
• Cash on Delivery refunds: collected at our store or via bank

📞 **To Start a Return:**
Contact us at support@gojoshop.et or call +251988664488. You can also chat with a support agent here!

Need help with a specific return? 😊

📱 **Mobile Payments (Recommended):**
• **Telebirr** — Pay instantly from your phone
• **CBE Birr** — Commercial Bank of Ethiopia mobile app
• **Amole** — Dashen Bank digital wallet

🏦 **Bank Transfer:**
• Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE)
• Awash Bank

bot.warranty_info:
🔧 **Warranty Information**

📅 **Coverage Periods:**
• Electronics (phones, laptops, tablets): **1-year** manufacturer warranty
• Home appliances: **6-month** warranty
• Clothing & accessories: **30-day** defect warranty
• Handmade/artisan products: **3-day** quality guarantee

✅ **What's Covered:**
• Manufacturing defects
• Hardware failures under normal use
• Missing or wrong parts from factory

❌ **What's NOT Covered:**
• Accidental damage (drops, spills)
• Normal wear and tear
• Unauthorized repairs or modifications
• Damage from improper use

📋 **How to Claim:**
1. Contact us at support@gojoshop.et
2. Provide your Order ID and a photo of the defect
3. Our team will arrange a free replacement or repair

For urgent warranty issues, call +251988664488. 😊
